name: pstack
description: Rigorous agent workflows from pstack by Lauren Tan, ported to Claude Code from its Qoder edition. A playbook-routing orchestrator, three-seat review panels, parallel arenas and swarms, independent verification, and 24 engineering principles, with each seat's model and effort set per call. Includes an enterprise layer: 18 specialist seats, 12 enterprise playbooks, PRD-to-business-rule cards, and opt-in approval-gate hooks on push, deploy, and migration commands.
